WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AS m UNION ALL SELECT m + INTERVAL 1 MONTH FROM months WHERE m < MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + INTERVAL 11 MONTH ) SELECT CONCAT(MONTH(months.m), '月') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(wsio.total_expected_quantity), 0) AS value FROM months LEFT JOIN wms_stock_in_orders wsio
ON COALESCE(wsio.expected_arrival_time, wsio.create_time) >= months.m AND COALESCE(wsio.expected_arrival_time, wsio.create_time) < months.m + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
AND wsio.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY months.m

WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) AS m UNION ALL SELECT m + INTERVAL 1 MONTH FROM months WHERE m < MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + INTERVAL 11 MONTH ) SELECT CONCAT(MONTH(months.m), '月') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(woo.total_quantity), 0) AS value FROM months LEFT JOIN wms_out_orders woo
ON COALESCE(woo.expected_ship_time, woo.create_time) >= months.m AND COALESCE(woo.expected_ship_time, woo.create_time) < months.m + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
AND woo.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY months.m

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wooi.packed_quantity), 0) AS total, wco.owner_name AS name FROM wms_out_orders_items wooi LEFT JOIN wms_out_orders woo ON wooi.order_id = woo.id LEFT JOIN wms_products wp ON wp.id = wooi.sku_id
LEFT JOIN wms_cargo_owners wco ON wco.id = COALESCE(woo.owner_id, wp.owner_id) WHERE 1 = 1
AND woo.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
GROUP BY COALESCE(woo.owner_id, wp.owner_id), wco.id, wco.owner_name ORDER BY total DESC
